question: Singhraj Adhana is associated with which of the following sports events?
solution:
The correct answer is shooting.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shooting:-**

 
 
• Shooting sports are a category of competitive and recreational activities involving proficiency tests of accuracy, precision, and speed in using various types of firearms, as well as archery.
 
 
 
• **Singhraj Adhana:-**
 
 
• He won silver medals at the Mixed Team 50m Pistol SH1 event in the ongoing Chateauroux Para-Shooting World Cup on 9 June 2022 in France.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton:-**

 
 
• It is a racquet sport played by either two opposing players (singles) or two opposing pairs (doubles), who take positions on opposite halves of a rectangular court divided by a net.
 
• Players score points by striking a shuttlecock with their racquet so that it lands within the marked boundaries of the opponents' court.
 
 
 
• **High jump:-**
 
 
• It is a track and field event in which competitors must jump as high as they can over a horizontal bar set at measured heights without the aid of certain devices.
 
• It's been part of the modern Olympic Games since its inception in 1896, and it's also included in the World Athletics Championships and other international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Discus throw:-**
 
 
• It is a track and field event in which an athlete throws a heavy disc—called a discus—in an attempt to mark a farther distance than their competitors.
 
• It is one of the oldest recorded events in athletics history, having been a part of the ancient Greek pentathlon, and it has been a sport in the modern Summer Olympic Games since the first Olympiad in 1896.
